rationale: The source explicitly supports the claim, describing a rare-event simulation framework using importance sampling to estimate accident probability (a risk metric) conditional on a base distribution of traffic behavior, a simulator, and a defined safety threshold. It contrasts this approach with the billions of miles required to statistically validate safety through real-world testing.
evidence_locators: PDF p. 2, base distribution and simulation inputs
limitations: The source is a research preprint and not a regulatory-approved safety case.
The estimated probability is strictly conditional on the chosen base distribution, simulator fidelity, and risk threshold, and does not prove unconditional safety.
